**EL-BEAM-1.4 High-beam telltale**

LightingIndication shall light Cluster_HighBeamTelltale while LeftHighBeamLightRequest or RightHighBeamLightRequest is 1.

description: Obligation of LightingIndication as LightingIndication in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-BEAM-1.4).
Refined by RationaleClaim_NonSafety_LightingIndication_BeamModes onto DIM alone; GWM and IHU take no part in the high-beam telltale.
